data.gateway.toml:
[openshell]
version = 2
[openshell.drivers.kubernetes]
allow_driver_config = false
client_tls_secret_name = "fixture-openshell-client-tls"
default_image = "nvcr.io/nvidia/base/ubuntu:24.04"
gateway_id = "${gateway_id}"
grpc_endpoint = "https://fixture-openshell.${core_namespace}.svc.cluster.local:8080"
namespace = "${core_namespace}"
provider_spiffe_workload_api_socket_path = "/spiffe-workload-api/spire-agent.sock"
sa_token_ttl_secs = 3600
sandbox_runtime = { boundary_port = 5500 }
sandbox_runtime_image = "ghcr.io/nvidia/openshell/sandbox@sha256:2658534bfb3f1ebba4bb7792e9e875a0972edbe7ae5f58d807ae22c46844a2ac"
sandbox_runtime_image_pull_policy = "if_not_present"
service_account_name = "fixture-openshell-sandbox"
supervisor_image = "${image.openshell_supervisor}"
supervisor_image_pull_policy = "if_not_present"
workspace_mode = "operator"
operator_namespace_file = "/etc/openshell/workspaces/namespaces.json"
[openshell.drivers.kubernetes.managed_ssh_ingress]
enabled = true
gateway_namespace = "${core_namespace}"
gateway_pod_selector = { "app.kubernetes.io/instance" = "fixture-openshell", "app.kubernetes.io/name" = "openshell" }
[openshell.drivers.kubernetes.resource_admission]
enabled = true
[openshell.gateway]
bind_address = "0.0.0.0:8080"
compute_driver = "kubernetes"
disable_tls = false
enable_loopback_service_http = true
enable_websocket_tunnel = false
health_bind_address = "0.0.0.0:8081"
log_level = "info"
metrics_bind_address = "0.0.0.0:9090"
name = "identity-demo-runtime"
policy_validation_failure_mode = "fail_closed"
server_sans = ["fixture-openshell.${core_namespace}.svc", "fixture-openshell.${core_namespace}.svc.cluster.local"]
[openshell.gateway.auth]
allow_unauthenticated_users = false
[openshell.gateway.credential_storage]
key_encryption_key_env = "OPENSHELL_GATEWAY_CREDENTIAL_KEY_ENCRYPTION_KEY"
[openshell.gateway.gateway_jwt]
gateway_id = "${gateway_id}"
kid_path = "/etc/openshell-jwt/kid"
public_key_path = "/etc/openshell-jwt/public.pem"
signing_key_path = "/etc/openshell-jwt/signing.pem"
ttl_secs = 3600
[openshell.gateway.oidc]
admin_role = "identity-demo-runtime-admin"
audience = "identity-demo-runtime"
issuer = "https://fixture-keycloak-${core_namespace}.${route_domain}/realms/identity-demo"
roles_claim = "realm_access.roles"
user_role = "identity-demo-runtime-user"
[openshell.gateway.tls]
cert_path = "/etc/openshell-tls/server/tls.crt"
client_ca_path = "/etc/openshell-tls/client-ca/ca.crt"
key_path = "/etc/openshell-tls/server/tls.key"
